scope: Document reader has its own menu, File manager can start where you choose, downloaded songs play, and email works through Thunderbird or Yahoo.

topics.title: Document reader menu
details: Document reader is now on the main menu.
Its menu lets you open a file, find one you read before, or change how it reads.
Control+O opens a document. Control+R lists the ones you read last.
In Document reader options, you can stop a file from being read aloud as soon as it opens.

topics.title: Where File manager starts
details: In File manager options, choose where File manager starts.
Pick the drive list, C drive, Documents, Desktop, Downloads, or Music. Or type a folder.

topics.title: Downloads
details: A song or video you downloaded now plays when you press Enter on it in Downloads.
Before, it would not play while a web page was open. This works in Chrome and in the built-in browser.

topics.title: Email through Thunderbird or Yahoo
details: Email now works through Thunderbird, or through a Yahoo account.
Gmail, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 work through Thunderbird.
If Voice Companion had its own Gmail or Outlook account, it is removed. You hear what to do next.
Your drafts and contacts are kept.
